name: NEXTDC S6 Sydney

address.note: the address comes from third-party listings (datacentermap, datacenterHawk); NEXTDC's ASX release did not name the address

lat.note: geocoded: address point for 3 Broadcast Way

developer.note: DA 2018/273 applicant (Lindsay Bennelong Developments Pty Ltd). Land owners at lodgement: Gore Hill Developments No 1, 2 and 3 Pty Ltd; owner at the 2019 modification: GH Cloud Management Pty Ltd (source 3). The modification report says the building 'will be operated concurrently with the existing Keppel data centre at 5 Broadcast Way'. Vendor to NEXTDC (Mar 2024) not named

mw_it.note: ASX release 12 Mar 2024: 'up to 13.5MW across 4,000m2 of data hall space' (verified); master.csv notes 2.7 MW built and 10.8 MW in progress

cost_aud_m.note: capital investment value $37,176,000 for DA 2018/273 (planning panel page; unchanged for mod DA 2018/273/A). Core-and-shell development CIV; NEXTDC paid A$184m for land plus completed core and shell (ASX 12 Mar 2024) and did its own fit-out

authority.note: Willoughby Council DA determined by the regional panel (panel ref PPS-2018SNH049; modification PPSSNH-23)

pathway.value: Regionally significant DA (council DA determined by planning panel)

reference.note: Willoughby DA for 'construction of a high technology industrial building for use as a purpose built data centre' at 3 Broadcast Way (Lot 3 DP 270714): four-storey building, data halls on floors 1, 2 and 4, 1,802 racks. Modified by DA 2018/273/A (lodged 13 Aug 2019, SNPP meeting 19 Feb 2020). An earlier DA 2014/223 (JRPP, CIV $24.64m) for a data centre on the same lot was superseded

lodged.note: lodgement date on the planning panel page and in the assessment report

determined.note: approved by SNPP, papers circulated electronically 14-21 Dec 2018 (Determination and Statement of Reasons)

jobs_construction.note: no construction jobs figure in the DA documents

jobs_operational.note: Council assessment report (2018SNH049): 'the data centre proposes to employ approximately 20 staff and that only 75% of the staff would be on site at any one time'

jobs_operational_other.note: modification report (PPSSNH-23): 'the maximum number of occupants present in the subject building during day time will be 8 and that night time will be 4' (shared operational personnel with the Keppel data centre at 5 Broadcast Way)

construction_end.note: ASX release (verified): 'Construction of the facility was completed in 1H of calendar 2022' (core and shell). NEXTDC fit-out and opening followed in 2024 (Wikipedia)

open_questions: core-and-shell builder unknown (Lindsay Bennelong was the DA applicant; whether it built the shell is unconfirmed); vendor to NEXTDC not named
NEXTDC fit-out builder and exact opening date (2024) not confirmed
